## Release Summary

- headline changes
- release or packaging changes
- new CLI, SDK, MCP, or scenario surface

## Onboarding / Install Impact

- install path changes
- upgrade path changes
- `verify_install` behavior changes

## Troubleshooting Impact

- new failure modes covered
- troubleshooting doc changes
- operator-facing recovery changes

## Quickstart Changes

- README quickstart changes
- first-hour guide changes
- user-visible command changes

## Validation

- unit tests
- hosted smoke tests
- self-hosted runtime smoke if relevant
- build + twine check
- TestPyPI install smoke
- manual notes

## Upgrade Notes

- breaking or behavior changes
- dependency or environment notes
- PyPI package link
